anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moves every PR-subject fact from fails to holds without losing the one fact Before already kept (failures: rejected push reported once with no retry/body edit and a menu return; body-edit failure retains the push and prints the block). The six-row menu with per-row PR consequences and stable numbering, the withheld-row treatment with both SHAs and the proven-only 'origin moved past' suffix, the full-SHA ref save plus the exact non-force `push --no-follow-tags origin HEAD:refs/heads/fix-timeout`, the pre-strip thread evidence with the single-naming-commit rule and complete-task fallback, the fresh post-push body fetch with exact bytes + blank line + Rework block, and the named-spec missing-prehead stop all read cleanly from the text. Two wording points are thin rather than wrong: the F3 row says 'If all pass' but never states that fresh successful evidence for every scoped command is required before Step 3.5/menu return — add a clause like 'implementer returns per-command pass evidence; any missing or failed command blocks the menu' so the hard-gate requirement is explicit rather than inferred; and the menu-layout reply rule is only shown for the withheld menu (`1` refused, naming 2-6) — one sentence stating that on the full menu a bare numeric reply is echoed as its mapped option before acting would make the render/reply contract visible for both menus. Keep the alias block, the single shared shell sequence, and the delta-only checkpoint table as they are; they are what let the landing, threads and body facts hold within the word budget.
